checks.outcome: The direction of the residue-field inclusion was checked from the stated y=f(x): the morphism induces a unital field homomorphism k(y) to k(x); its kernel is an ideal of a field and cannot contain 1, hence it is zero. This supports the leftward hooked arrow as written. It does not settle the overwritten argument glyph.

Composing the given geometric-point map Spec Ω to X with f:X to Y yields a geometric point of Y because Ω remains the same separably closed field. This verifies only the elementary composition claim visible on this page, not the unstated identifications of the chosen fundamental groups.
